messages.author: 27debeac26f66a0b
messages.subject: Sampler
parts:
Dear Nimble Team,


Thank you very much for your continuous improvements in this great software, and for your work solving the questions in this group.


I'm trying to use a constrained sampler like that kindly Perry de Valpine posted here some time ago (https://groups.google.com/forum/#!searchin/nimble-users/dsum%7Csort:date/nimble-users/z1o2Fi9bO1A/Ae2HE71qFAAJ) but using a tridimensional latent node y[i,j, k] and a constraint node C[i,j,k], to sample while obey the constraints "y = C". C is the sum of two nodes, one observed, and other partially observed

 

RW_constrained <- nimbleFunction(

    contains = sampler_BASE,

    setup = function(model, mvSaved, target, control) {

        scale = control$scale

        constraintNode <- control$constraintNode

        calcNodes <- model$getDependencies(target)

    },

    run = function() {

        target_vals <- values(model, target)

        current_w <- target_vals

        if(abs(model[[constraintNode]] - current_w) > 1e-6) print('Looks like the constraint is being violated\n');

        values(model, target) <<- target_vals

        accept <- decide(calculateDiff(model, calcNodes))

        if(accept) {

            copy(from = model, to = mvSaved, row = 1, nodes = calcNodes, logProb = TRUE)

        } else {

            copy(from = mvSaved, to = model, row = 1, nodes = calcNodes, logProb = TRUE)

        }

    },

    methods = list(

        reset = function() {}

    )

)

 

I compiled:

...

mcmcspec$removeSamplers('y')

mcmcspec$addSampler(target = c('y'), type = RW_constrained, control = list(scale = 0.5, constraintNode = c('C')))

...

 

but I get this error:

CMCMC <- compileNimble(MCMC, project = Rmodel)

compiling... this may take a minute. Use 'showCompilerOutput = TRUE' to see C++ compilation details.

Error: In sizeBinaryCwise: Dimensions do not matchin a way that can be handled.

 This occurred for: map("model_oB_oBconstraintNode_cB_cB",3,name,list,list) - current_w

 This was part of the call:  abs(map("model_oB_oBconstraintNode_cB_cB",3,name,list,list) - current_w)

 

How could I solve it?

Thank you

messages.author: 5fa2a363d4ddd1d1
messages.subject: Re: Sampler
parts:
Hi Jose,

I suspect the issue is that the result of using value() is one-dimensional (i.e., a vector not a scalar), so 
target_values and therefore current_w are one-dimensional as well and can't be compared against model[[constraintNode]].

Can you try:
abs(model[[constraintNode]] - current_w[1] 

and see if that works?

I'm assuming that 'constraintNode' is a scalar ...

Chris

messages.author: 5fa2a363d4ddd1d1
messages.subject: Re: Sampler
parts:
hi Jose, in your RW_constrained, it should look like this (i.e., only have the [1] indexing when you use current_w, not when it is created. 

        current_w <- target_vals
        if(abs(model[[constraintNode]] - current_w[1]) > 1e-6) print('Looks like the constraint is being violated\n')

The NIMBLE compiler will create current_w as a vector and then in the next line, you use the first element. 

That will solve the particular error. However, there is a bigger issue here - 'constraintNode' is 'C' in your model, and that is a 3-d array.
But you are comparing to an individual element of 'y.full', which is a scalar.  I think you probably need to have the constraintNode
for each element of 'y.full' be the corresponding element of 'C'.

Chris
Chris
